_comment: The reference-data instance's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/reference_data_PRD.md §4.11, §4.16). One slot
the application binds in its own security.json, or startup is refused:
Read only: reference types are written by imports and the seed, never through the generic UI, so no New, Edit or
Delete right exists. No anonymous right either: /spark/* answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * by default, so an
anonymous grant here would be a second, unversioned public API. The public contract is /api/v1.
